title: VehicleDef
description:
A vehicle prototype definition from JSON type `"vehicle"`.

Defines a vehicle blueprint with its layout, parts, items, and fuel. Vehicles can inherit from abstract prototypes via `copy-from`.

abstract_.description: If true, this is an abstract definition that should not appear in the final registry.

blueprint.description: Blueprint grid representing the vehicle layout (array of strings or array of arrays).

copy_from.description: Reference to another vehicle definition to copy from.

items.description: Items that may spawn inside the vehicle. Can be a sequence of item spawn objects or a single item group string.

parts.description: List of parts at each grid position.

LocalizedString.description:
A localized string that may contain translations for multiple languages.

In CDDA JSON, this appears as: ```json { "str": "name", "//~": "context" } { "str_sp": "name" }           // same for singular & plural { "str_pl": "names" }          // explicit plural ``` Or as a plain string `"name"`.

For Stage 1 we store the raw English text. Full i18n support (extracting translations) is deferred.

anyOf.description: A localized object with optional plural and context.

VehicleBlueprintPart.description: A single part placement in a vehicle blueprint.

parts.description: List of part IDs or part objects at this position.

x.description: X coordinate in the blueprint grid.

y.description: Y coordinate in the blueprint grid.
